scenes.title: Research reality
scenes.accessibleDescription: Check the existing form before choosing what to build around it.

scenes.title: Four evidence labels
scenes.accessibleDescription: Different labels prevent a plan from being mistaken for current reality.

scenes.title: Trace one inquiry
scenes.accessibleDescription: Follow a form submission through validation, storage, and its outcome.

scenes.title: Compare the options
scenes.accessibleDescription: The form-only release and an email importer have different tradeoffs.

scenes.title: Decision ledger
scenes.accessibleDescription: Record the choice, rationale, status, and when it should be revisited.

scenes.title: Turn unknowns into work
scenes.accessibleDescription: Keep planning possible while naming what still needs to be checked.

scenes.title: Evidence walkthrough
scenes.accessibleDescription: A local test can prove a source-level claim without proving the live site.

scenes.title: Ask a focused question
scenes.accessibleDescription: Targeted research produces a useful answer and a traceable source.

scenes.title: Fair comparison
scenes.accessibleDescription: Give each choice its benefits, limits, dependencies, and risks.

scenes.title: Owner decisions
scenes.accessibleDescription: The owner decides material changes to scope, access, or real-world effects.

scenes.title: A reusable decision
scenes.accessibleDescription: A future teammate should understand what was chosen and why.

scenes.title: New facts, new plan
scenes.accessibleDescription: A changed observation can overturn an assumption and alter the design.

scenes.title: Decide with uncertainty
scenes.accessibleDescription: Label a provisional choice and explain what would change it.
